context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B & C of IronVision GRC upgrade complete. Key features: (1) Dynamic Risk Scoring (Phase B) - GET /api/risk-scoring/org-score returns aggregate org risk with 5 weighted factors: SIEM (25%), Compliance (25%), Pipeline (20%), Ingestion (15%), Policy (15%). Risk levels: critical (80+), high (60+), elevated (40+), moderate (20+), low (0+). GET /api/risk-scoring/framework-scores returns per-framework risk with compliance stats and policy coverage. GET /api/risk-scoring/trend?days=N returns risk history. GET /api/risk-scoring/alerts returns active alerts (SIEM critical events, pipeline failures, non-compliant controls, unmapped ingested controls, stale assessments). (2) Policy-as-Code (Phase C) - GET /api/policy-engine/rules returns 8 built-in rules (PAC-001 to PAC-008) covering encryption, MFA, public access, logging, TLS version, backups, secrets, tagging. POST /api/policy-engine/evaluate evaluates JSON config against rules, returns violations with severity and mapped control IDs. POST /api/policy-engine/rules creates custom rules. GET /api/policy-engine/evaluations lists evaluation history. (3) Drift Detection (Phase C) - POST /api/policy-engine/drift/snapshot creates compliance baseline capturing all framework compliance states, pipeline stats, and ingestion stats. GET /api/policy-engine/drift/detect compares current state vs baseline, returns changes with direction (improved/degraded). GET /api/policy-engine/drift/snapshots lists all snapshots. (4) Frontend - Risk Scoring button opens dashboard with org score gauge, 5 factor breakdown, alerts section, framework risk scores, and trend chart. Policy-as-Code button opens view with 4 tabs: Evaluate Config (JSON editor + results), Policy Rules (8 built-in rules displayed), Drift Detection (create snapshot + detect drift), History (evaluation history). All 5 action buttons present on Frameworks page: Policy-as-Code, Risk Scoring, DevSecOps Pipeline, Ingestion Layer, Organize.
